# Module E: ADAM training record

## 1. Purpose

This report records one Module E training run. The optimized loss is the single target-bit deterministic local loss, not the maximum or sum over all four block bits.

## 2. Command

```bash
python task2_code/run_module_e_training_with_report.py --n-qubits 4 --block 0,1,2,3 --target-bit 1 --radius 0 --iterations 0 --restarts 1 --target-seed 42 --training-seed 1042 --lr 0.01 --fd-eps 1e-05 --output-dir task2_code\module_e_validation_output\report_script_smoke --report-path task2_code\module_e_validation_output\report_script_smoke\report.md
```
